result.title: SE-Mem: Semantic-Episodic Memory for Scene-Consistent Generative View Synthesis
result.summary: Generative view synthesis aims to synthesize novel-view videos from reference observations along user-defined camera trajectories. Maintaining global scene consistency throughout this process remains challenging for camera-conditioned interactive video generators. Existing approaches typically select reference frames based solely on camera poses, overlooking whether the content remains semantically relevant or even visible. To address these limitations, we draw inspiration from semantic and episodic memory in human cognition, in which semantic memory captures generalized knowledge across experiences, whereas episodic memory preserves information tied to specific past events and contexts. Motivated by the complementary roles of semantic and episodic memory, we introduce SE-Mem, a Semantic-Episodic Memory framework that organizes historical observations in a structured 3D representation and augments its elements with semantic importance scores. A two-stage memory retrieval strategy is designed to identify the most informative frames to provide contextual guidance. Taking into account both semantic significance and geometric visibility, SE-Mem preserves semantic coherence and fine-grained visual details during novel view synthesis. Extensive evaluations show that our approach improves visual quality and achieves competitive geometric consistency across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向相机轨迹条件下的生成式新视角合成，提出 SE-Mem：将历史观测组织为结构化 3D 表示并附加语义重要性分数，再用两阶段检索挑选兼顾语义相关与几何可见性的参考帧以维持场景一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按语义重要性与可见性对视觉观测打分并检索的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与历史状态/缓存保留策略提供线索，但任务目标是视图合成，与推理状态生成的联系需人工核查。
